claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 'Canon' logo and 'MarkIII' lettering on the body
No batteries visible in any photo
No charger visible in any photo
No trigger visible in any photo
No shutter-count screen or software readout shown; top LCD digits are described as unclear

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: All photos show the body with a cap on the lens mount; no lens is present in any image, so a lens condition cannot exist to be clean

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or internal/repair evidence shown; mount cap blocks mirror/sensor view

risks.risk: No lens is actually included despite seller describing lens condition
risks.proof: Photo of the actual lens (front and rear element) attached or beside the body

risks.risk: Accessories (batteries, charger, Godox trigger) may not be included or may be non-original
risks.proof: A single photo showing all listed accessories together with the body, charger plugged in, and Godox trigger visible

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or screen may be faulty
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the camera powered on with the rear screen displaying a live image or menu

risks.risk: True shutter count unknown, could exceed claimed 5,000
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count read via Canon utility software or a shutter-count checking site screenshot

risks.risk: Sensor, mirror, or mount damage hidden behind the body cap
risks.proof: A photo with the cap removed showing the mirror box and sensor

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear (scratches, dents) not visible due to lighting and limited angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides including top, bottom, and grip in bright even light

proof_requests: Photo of the lens itself (if any lens is actually included)
Photo showing both batteries, the charger, and the Godox trigger together with the body
Video of the camera powering on with screen active
Screenshot of shutter count from Canon EOS Utility or similar
Photo with the body cap removed showing mirror/sensor
Full 360-degree close-up photos in good lighting for cosmetic condition
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark III body, so it can be priced at worst case as a body-only, unverified-functionality unit; accessory, condition, and lens claims remain unproven and lower the baseline price until supporting photos are provided.
